name: card
title: Card
use_for: Series and math explainers: one idea per card on a plain page; the card swipes away and the next lands. Thin coloured stick people, line icons, vectors in JetBrains Mono, math in STIX Two.

components.vector:
name = [ n n n ... ]
(grid of spans: .name, .n)
components.lines: class="pen ln|fst|thr|yel" (+ bar when straight); .dashed for paths; text on the page itself gets .onpage

variants.page: white (default) | green: <body data-page="green"> (green paper surface, tools/make_surface.py)
